Is sound-dai required? And additionalProperties is false? I think we
need that yet again.

> +
> +      codec:
> +        description: Holds subnode which indicates codec dai.
> +        type: object
> +        properties:
> +          sound-dai: true
> +

Same here.

> +    required:
> +      - link-name
> +      - cpu
> +      - codec
> +      - reg
> +
> +    additionalProperties: false
